confirmed that the ceremony would no longer air on [[TNT (American TV network)|TNT]] and [[TBS (American TV channel)|TBS]] (the ceremony had aired on TNT since [[4th Screen Actors Guild Awards|1998]] and had been also broadcast on TBS since [[12th Screen Actors Guild Awards|2006]]); a spokesperson insisted that finding a new home for the ceremony "is not unusual and has occurred several times over the history of the SAG Awards. This is no different".{{cite web |url=https://variety.com/2022/tv/news/sag-awards-tnt-tbs-1235258176/ |title=SAG Awards Will No Longer Air on TNT and TBS After 25 Years |first=Michael |last=Schneider |work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |date=May 5, 2022 |access-date=January 11, 2023 |archive-date=January 10, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230110113306/https://variety.com/2022/tv/news/sag-awards-tnt-tbs-1235258176/ |url-status=live}} The day of the nominations announcement, it was confirmed that the ceremony would stream live on [[Netflix]]'s [[YouTube]] channel. ''[[The Banshees of Inisherin]]'' and ''[[Everything Everywhere All at Once]]'' both received five nominations, tying the record for the most nominations in SAG Awards history with ''[[Shakespeare in Love]]'' (1998), ''[[Chicago (2002 film)|Chicago]]'' (2002), and ''[[Doubt (2008 film)|Doubt]]'' (2008).{{cite web |url=https://variety.com/2023/awards/awards/sag-awards-nominations-2023-1235482418/
